title: Planning graph lifecycle core
description: Objective: implement immutable planning runs, plan revisions, graph revisions, exact-hash approval, and the single-node activation gate. Deliverable: focused planning modules in packages/core with typed transition/property tests. NOT in scope: multi-node execution, scheduler dispatch, providers, or persistence. Hard dependencies: Runtime contract registry and Project goal lifecycle core. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: Initial plan and graph proposal finalizes atomically and approval binds exact immutable hashes.
Any graph with more than one execution-bearing node returns typed UNSUPPORTED throughout Foundation Preview.
Draft planning cannot mutate active execution authority or reuse stale approval bytes.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
